title: Blam! Machinehead
native_title: ブラム！ マシーンヘッド
overview:
Pounding bass-heavy techno sound! A hard-hitting 3D shooter in which you race through a ruined world, wrapped in cyberpunk excitement. The curtain rises now!

In the year 2020, a nanotechnology experiment gone wrong has turned one man into a living mass of gray goo that has swallowed most of the life on Earth. Scientist Dr. Kimberly Stride sets out across the goo-covered wastelands aboard an armed hovercraft, carrying a nuclear bomb meant for the creature's heart.

Seen from the cockpit, you steer the hovercraft through the devastated landscape, blasting enemies and obstacles as you push on toward each objective on the map.

重低音ひびくテクノサウンド！サイバーパンクな興奮につつまれながら荒廃した世界を駆け抜ける迫力の3Dシューティング。今、その幕を開ける！
